aboutText: Beauty by Nam is a bridal and occasion hair and makeup service based in Leicester. Nam works with brides across Leicestershire and the East Midlands, and travels for weddings elsewhere in the UK and abroad. Every look is created around the individual, from the first conversation to the final finishing touch.
thankYou: Thank you for taking the time to consider Beauty by Nam for your special day. It would be a pleasure to be part of it. Please find your personalised quotation on the following pages, and do get in touch if you would like to change anything.
keyTerms: A deposit is required to secure your date. Your date is only reserved once the deposit has been received.
Travel costs are charged in addition to the service prices and are shown as a separate line on this quotation.
The remaining balance is due before the day, as stated on this quotation.
Please let Nam know of any allergies or skin sensitivities before your booking.
